notes: Access: direct fetch worked with no blocking (Shopify storefront, lang=de, EUR pricing). Rule 3 sanity check: genuine live retailer - Impressum referenced from Kundenservice page, well-known established German homeware chain (BUTLERS, Cologne), full catalog of 1655 SKUs in 'Alle Artikel', normal seasonal 'End of Summer Sale' banner (no liquidation/closing-down language) - matches known facts about the brand, not a scam domain. Category tree from the mega-menu (all sub-items confirmed present in page HTML, not truncated). Qty verification: products.json paged to exhaustion (unique product IDs, /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250) for every included row; cross-validated against the rendered '<N> Produkte' header text on 3 sample pages (Kerzenhalter, Karaffen & Kruege, Lichterketten) - exact match in all 3. The site's own collections.json 'products_count' field proved inflated on every category checked (e.g. Kerzenhalter 91 reported vs 54 actual; Karaffen & Kruege 42 vs 28; Lichterketten 59 vs 34; Vasen 68 vs 54; Teller 61 vs 45) - qty values below use the exhaustion count, not products_count. No mirrors product line exists on this site (search for 'spiegel' returned only a novelty Christmas/party 'Disco Spiegel Wolke' decoration, not a mirror category) - Wall Decor & Mirrors bucket has no rows. Rule 0.6 dedup: 'Blumentoepfe & Uebertoepfe' (Dekoration nav branch) and 'Pflanzgefaesse' (Garten & Balkon nav branch) are the identical collection (100% product-ID overlap, 30/30 unique products) reached via two nav paths - emitted once, documented here rather than under two rows. Excluded and why: Duftkerzen (scented candles, home fragrance); the entire Raumduefte/Diffuser/Duftoele/Raumspray/Raeucherstabchen home-fragrance section; Kunstpflanzen (artificial plants); Blumen and Trockenblumen (product-title check showed both are 100% dried/artificial florals - 'Trockenblumen', 'Kunstblume' - no real flowers, so both excluded as botanical/faux decor); Gartendeko (product-title check: 4 of 6 items were seat cushions/textile, the other 2 duplicated Gartenbeleuchtung's solar-light products - mixed roll-up, dropped); Bad-Accessoires (product-title check: soap dispensers, soap dishes, toothbrush cups, storage tins, shower curtains, bath mats - bathroom hardware/utility per Rule 0.4, not decorative); Duschvorhaenge, Badmoebel; Wohnaccessoires (product-title check: 41-item collection dominated by side tables, shelves, garden/lounge chairs, wine racks, trash cans, storage tins, laundry baskets - a mixed furniture/storage roll-up, only ~2 of 37 sampled items were decor-adjacent - dropped entirely, its own nav children Koerbe/baskets and Moebel/furniture are both non-decor too); Koerbe (storage baskets/bags); Untersetzer/coasters (nested in the excluded Tischwaesche table-linens branch); all of Tischwaesche (Tischdecken, Tischlaeufer, Tischsets, Servietten - table linens); Besteck (cutlery); Kuechenhelfer & Aufbewahrung except Tabletts (Dosen & Vorratsglaeser storage jars, Schneidebretter cutting boards, Geschirrhandtuecher dish towels, Muelleimer trash cans, Kuechenutensilien kitchen utensils - all functional kitchen tools/storage); LED-Leuchtmittel (light bulbs); all furniture (Moebel, Outdoormoebel, Balkonmoebel, Gartenmoebel und Lounges, Gartentische, Gartenstuehle, Sonnenschirme & Schirmstaender - the last also had 0 products); Outdoortextilien; Wohntextilien (Bettwaesche, Kissen & Decken, Stuhlkissen & Sitzkissen, Handtuecher, Waermflaschen & Handwaermer); marketing/seasonal collections (Bestseller, Neu, Sale, Halloween, Silvester, Weihnachtsdeko, Geschenkideen and its price-tier variants, Peanuts, Spring Picnic, Brunch & Breakfast Club, Garden BBQ, Cocktail Party). Stumpenkerzen and Stabkerzen kept (title check: unscented decorative pillar/taper/LED candles, no fragrance language) while Duftkerzen (scented) dropped, per the candle rule.
